name: Nasu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nasu town emblem in white: an outlined ring open at the top enclosing a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Nasu, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 September 1963.

features.role: Nasu town emblem — an outlined ring open at the top enclosing a stylised mountain
